candidates.change_summary: Change the > operator to >= in the if condition so that Deposit succeeds when msg.value equals MinDeposit.
Remove the require overflow check so that wrapping behavior can occur on large deposits, changing final balance.
Replace msg.sender with a constant zero address in the balance update, so balance changes for address(0) instead of caller.
Delete the if guard so that Deposit always updates balances regardless of msg.value, including zero.
Remove the addition of msg.value by replacing += with = 0, always setting the caller's balance to zero.
Insert a premature return before the balance update so that Deposit can never change balances.
The CashOut amount guard now allows cashing out one unit more than the stored balance.
Move the balance subtraction from before the external call to after the external call succeeds, creating a reentrancy window before state is updated.
Subtract the CashOut amount using addition instead of subtraction, increasing the stored balance instead of decreasing it.
Treat a failed external call as success by logging instead of reverting, leaving the balance update in place when the ether transfer fails.
Change the CashOut balance check from _am <= balances[msg.sender] to _am < balances[msg.sender], making an exact full-balance withdrawal revert.
Swap the order of the state update and the external call in CashOut, subtracting the balance only after the external call returns.
Invert the post-call success condition so a successful external call reverts and an unsuccessful one completes.
Change the deposit guard from strict greater-than to greater-than-or-equal, allowing deposits equal to MinDeposit.
Replace the overflow-style require guard with a tautological require(true), removing the only explicit revert on a normal payable deposit.
Delete the balance update so the deposit no longer credits the sender.
Delete the external AddMessage log call so no log is recorded while the deposit still succeeds.
